# CANDIDATE: VIX15_FILTER_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX>15 filter for BEARISH_REJECTION entries will improve edge by avoiding low-VIX environments where put premiums are thin and moves tend to fizzle, while preserving the core edge on J anchor days which occurred in moderate-to-high VIX regimes.

## Mechanism

For BEARISH_REJECTION entries, require that the VIX (as of entry time) is greater than 15. This filter is applied alongside existing context filters (time of day, SPY structure, EMA ribbon flip, etc.). Exit logic remains unchanged: chart stop (primary), chandelier profit-lock, premium stop (catastrophe cap), and time stop.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline  
2. **Sample bias:** Using last 4 months of data (approx 2026-03-01 to 2026-06-30) for walk-forward OOS risks overfit to recent regime; small sample may not capture all volatility environments  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward OOS on last 4 months pending; requires WF>=0.70 and ≤2 negative quarters)  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top-3 J day validation vs BS-sim <±20% deviation pending)  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: missing a low-VIX winner if market moves sharply despite low VIX  
   - Max drawdown: potential increase if filter admits losing trades in high-VIX chop  
   - Blow-up: gap risk remains; VIX>15 does not prevent catastrophic moves against position  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L  

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators must pass; walk-forward OOS on last 4 months must show WF>=0.70 and sub-window stability (≤2 quarters negative); real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show <±20% P&L deviation from BS-sim.
